column_description: Username of the user. may be NULL.
Email address of the user. may be NULL.
Role of the user (e.g., operations manager, data analyst). always exactly one of 'operations manager', 'data analyst'. may be NULL.
Last time the user logged in. may be NULL.
Date and time the user account was created. may be NULL.
Date and time the user account was last updated. may be NULL.
Status of the user account (e.g., active, inactive). always exactly one of 'active', 'inactive'. may be NULL.
